title: File Explorer — Tree + CRUD + Breadcrumb
description: A complete, backend-agnostic file explorer: a directory tree sidebar, breadcrumb navigation with history, grid and list views, full CRUD (new folder, rename, move, copy, delete/Trash), drag-and-drop upload and move (files AND folders, structure preserved), a right-click context menu, multi-select (cmd/shift), and keyboard shortcuts. Storage is pluggable via an injectable FileExplorerAdapter (host fs / S3 / Convex / your own); the slice ships an in-memory mock so the whole UI is demoable with zero backend.
